Supersedes the `Latest` comment. Jack Heart (2026-11-12): "i guess latest is a bit weird because it makes it not idempotent". No `Latest` seat: every relative seat must resolve to the same checkpoint whenever it is held. Instead `Final(job=..., inference=...)`: the other job's final checkpoint, a gap until that job has finished (failed: its last stored checkpoint, as `TrainingRun` defines an end). Final vs final is the subject held at its final checkpoint against `Final`. Comparing against a chosen checkpoint of another job stays a fixed `Model` seat chosen in eval.
